summary: V3R1_LOCAL_CHAIN_VERSIONED_CUTOVER_READY. Frozen bytes prove a false-green boundary: scripts/verify_local_research_active_chain.ps1 validates a self-consistent historical V3 five-task chain and old V3 dispatch/runner bindings, but never binds them to the deployed exporter’s V3R1 task, manifest type/schema or export root. The exporter targets local-node-microstructure-v3r1-evidence-diagnostic-v1, MICROSTRUCTURE_DISCOVERY_V3R1_CREATE_ONLY_HANDOFF_MANIFEST, the V3R1 manifest schema and /var/lib/agora-research/microstructure-v3r1-handoff-export. In contrast, the pull script, receiver, diagnostic runner and interpretation runner bind the old V3 task/root/schema chain. One bounded 11-file versioned cutover can close transfer through terminal diagnostic interpretation while preserving every historical V3 byte and all unchanged diagnostic formulas and simplest-first interpretation gates. Stage 1 ends after create-once V3R1 interpretation output; hypothesis-design and positive economic-route runners remain untouched and require a separately frozen positive-only task only if interpretation is positive. Immediate PnL and drawdown effects are zero. Completion, prediction, fees, slippage, capacity, candidate readiness, OOS and deployment remain MISSING_PROOF.
